entries.en: One person at a time, please.
Mhm. Everything appears to be in order.
We'll finish this later.
It's because of what happened in Europe.
entries.ro: E de la ce s-a întâmplat în Europa.

entries.en: Why's this taking so long?
Mhm, I heard. Data leak in Frankfurt.
entries.ro: Mhm, am auzit. Scurgere de date la Frankfurt.

entries.en: Ugh. Half-brain management we're gonna pay for in sweat.
entries.ro: Ugh. Management de doi bani, o să ne coste sudoare.

entries.en: I'll call you on an encrypted line.
entries.ro: Te sun pe o linie criptată.

entries.en: Have a nice day.
V, you there?
Ah, yeah… ahem, yeah, I'm here.
entries.en_m: Ah, yeah, khe khe… yeah, I'm here.
entries.ro: Ah, da… khe khe, da, sunt aici.
entries.ro_m: Ah, da, khe khe… da, sunt aici.

entries.en: Er, sounded like you blew your gut's airlock…
entries.ro: Ăă, părea că ți-a cedat ecluza stomacului…

entries.en: Nah, yeah, I barfed. It's just stress.
entries.en_m: Yeah, I barfed. It's just stress.
entries.ro: Nah, da, am vomitat. E doar stres.
entries.ro_m: Da, am vomitat. E doar stres.

entries.en: You all right?
Khe, fine, ahem. Just... needed a breather.
entries.en_m: Khe, fine. Just, uh... needed a breather.
entries.ro: Khe, bine, khe. Doar... aveam nevoie de-o pauză.
entries.ro_m: Khe, bine. Doar, ăă... aveam nevoie de-o pauză.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="mex" o="Agh, esa chamba te va a matar." t="Job's gonna kill you." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="mex" o="Agh, esa chamba te va a matar." t="Jobul te omoară." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Everyone's a critic.
Don't worry. I'm not dead yet.
entries.ro: Nu-ți face griji. Nu sunt moartă încă.
entries.ro_m: Nu-ți face griji. Nu sunt mort încă.

entries.en: Yeah, maybe I shoulda gotten a safe one. Like you did.
entries.ro: Da, poate ar fi trebuit să iau una sigură. Ca tine.

entries.en: Not dead yet.
We had a leak. My boss called, dragged me in because we had to... intervene. Everyone at Night City HQ is on edge.
entries.en_m: We had a leak. My boss called, dragged me in because we had to intervene. Everyone at Night City HQ is on edge.
entries.ro: Am avut o scurgere. Șeful meu a sunat, m-a tras deoparte pentru că trebuia să intervenim. Toată lumea de la HQ-ul din Night City e cu nervii întinși.

entries.en: But no way you're fucked, right? Hey, you're the one who fixes other people's shit.
entries.ro: Dar nu ești terminată, nu? Hei, tu ești cea care repară rahaturile altora.
entries.ro_m: Dar nu ești terminat, nu? Hei, tu ești cel care repară rahaturile altora.

entries.en: Jackie, if you work in Arasaka counterintel, you're always fucked.
entries.ro: Jackie, dacă lucrezi la contrainformațiile Arasaka, ești mereu futut.

entries.en: Listen, gotta go. Work won't do itself.
entries.ro: Ascultă, trebuie să plec. Treaba nu se face singură.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="mex" o="Buena suerte." t="G'luck." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="mex" o="Buena suerte." t="Baftă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Hey, least I always know who's shootin' at me, sometimes even why.
entries.ro: Hei, cel puțin știu mereu cine trage în mine, uneori și de ce.

entries.en: Anyway, what's goin' on?
Exactly – "yet."
Is there a problem?
Is there a problem?
[Answer call]
[Stand] Gotta go.
[Stand] Don't worry about me.
Don't worry about me. I'll manage on my own.
entries.ro: Nu-ți face griji de mine. Mă descurc singură.
entries.ro_m: Nu-ți face griji de mine. Mă descurc singur.

entries.en: It's just stress.
I'm fine.
Somebody turned coat, gave up our agents.
Talk to me, choomba.
Hey, you all there, V?
